implemented_since_last_handoff: Physical 0703 test established all four logical lanes: client active=1,2,3,4 and server bound lane 1..4. Single-lane was healthy, but in 4-lane Game rotation lane1 passed and lane2/lane3 replacement candidates observed DEMO_BIND_OK witness mismatch followed by WBD_LANE_ROTATION_RETRY.

Code inspection pinned the 4-lane physical-slot recycle sequence: initial slots 1,2,3,4; lane1 replacement uses spare slot5; after lane1 promotion old slot1 becomes lane2 candidate slot; after lane2 promotion old slot2 becomes lane3 candidate slot.
DEMO_BIND_OK is LINK startup Reality-ticket binding. A witness mismatch means a candidate received a valid BindOK for another/old startup ticket/incarnation; it is not a Game membership ACK failure.
The lane-age monitor replaces one lane at a time, so the symptom is not lane2/lane3 concurrently racing for the spare slot.

Found a deterministic Windows lifecycle gap: osProcess.Stop called Process.Kill and returned without waiting for exec.Cmd.Wait/p.done. StopDynamicLanePlan therefore could declare a retired physical slot reusable while the old LINK/DTLS/FakeTCP child was not yet fully exited/reaped.

Added internal/windowsruntime/process_retirement.go with a bounded osProcess WaitStopped barrier, and changed StopDynamicLanePlan to Stop then wait for actual child exit before retiring each LINK -> DTLS -> FakeTCP process.
Added dynamic_lane_retirement_test.go to require stop/wait ordering and propagate retirement wait failures. No wire format, lane count, membership op, DTLS, FakeTCP or Game protocol was changed.

Local exact-source go test ./internal/windowsruntime passed for 99976756dd93a42b1b58e091672d6ffce999a2d4. Exact-source netem/throughput and a cross-platform Windows-wire/Linux-consumer check were already green when this handoff was written; additional full-stack/Windows jobs were still queued or running.
